text: Lovely weather today, isn't it?
ipa: /ˈlʌvli ˈweðər təˈdeɪ ˈɪzənt ɪt/
meaningVi: Hôm nay trời đẹp quá nhỉ?
example: A: Lovely weather today, isn't it? — B: Yes, perfect for a walk.

text: It's been raining all week, I'm so tired of it.
ipa: /ɪts bɪn ˈreɪnɪŋ ɔːl wiːk aɪm soʊ ˈtaɪərd əv ɪt/
meaningVi: Mưa suốt cả tuần, tôi chán lắm rồi.
example: A: Another rainy day! — B: I know. It's been raining all week, I'm so tired of it.

text: Did you do anything fun over the weekend?
ipa: /dɪd jə duː ˈeniθɪŋ fʌn ˈoʊvər ðə ˈwiːkend/
meaningVi: Cuối tuần vừa rồi bạn có làm gì vui không?
example: A: Did you do anything fun over the weekend? — B: I went hiking with some friends.

text: Do you have any plans for the holidays?
ipa: /də jə hæv ˈeni plænz fər ðə ˈhɑːlədeɪz/
meaningVi: Kỳ nghỉ sắp tới bạn đã có kế hoạch gì chưa?
example: A: Do you have any plans for the holidays? — B: I'm going back to my hometown.

text: What do you like to do in your free time?
ipa: /wʌt də jə laɪk tə duː ɪn jər friː taɪm/
meaningVi: Lúc rảnh rỗi bạn thích làm gì?
example: A: What do you like to do in your free time? — B: I like reading and playing badminton.

text: How long have you been living here?
ipa: /haʊ lɔːŋ həv jə bɪn ˈlɪvɪŋ hɪr/
meaningVi: Bạn sống ở đây được bao lâu rồi?
example: A: How long have you been living here? — B: About three years now.

text: Have you seen any good movies lately?
ipa: /həv jə siːn ˈeni ɡʊd ˈmuːviz ˈleɪtli/
meaningVi: Dạo này bạn có xem được phim nào hay không?
example: A: Have you seen any good movies lately? — B: Yes, I watched a great comedy last week.

text: I've just started learning to play the guitar.
ipa: /aɪv dʒʌst ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈlɜːrnɪŋ tə pleɪ ðə ɡɪˈtɑːr/
meaningVi: Tôi mới bắt đầu học chơi đàn guitar.
example: A: Any new hobbies? — B: I've just started learning to play the guitar.

text: Did you hear about the new shopping mall downtown?
ipa: /dɪd jə hɪr əˈbaʊt ðə nuː ˈʃɑːpɪŋ mɔːl ˌdaʊnˈtaʊn/
meaningVi: Bạn nghe tin về cái trung tâm thương mại mới trong phố chưa?
example: A: Did you hear about the new shopping mall downtown? — B: Yes! I heard it opens next week.

text: That sounds like a lot of fun!
ipa: /ðæt saʊndz laɪk ə lɑːt əv fʌn/
meaningVi: Nghe vui ghê!
example: A: We went camping by the lake. — B: That sounds like a lot of fun!

text: Really? Tell me more about it.
ipa: /ˈrɪli tel mi mɔːr əˈbaʊt ɪt/
meaningVi: Thật á? Kể thêm cho tôi nghe đi.
example: A: I'm moving to Japan next year. — B: Really? Tell me more about it.

text: I know what you mean, the same thing happened to me.
ipa: /aɪ noʊ wʌt jə miːn ðə seɪm θɪŋ ˈhæpənd tə mi/
meaningVi: Tôi hiểu mà, tôi cũng từng bị y chang vậy.
example: A: My flight was delayed for five hours! — B: I know what you mean, the same thing happened to me.

text: It's so hot today, I can't stop sweating.
ipa: /ɪts soʊ hɑːt təˈdeɪ aɪ kænt stɑːp ˈswetɪŋ/
meaningVi: Hôm nay nóng quá, mồ hôi cứ chảy ròng ròng.
example: A: It's so hot today, I can't stop sweating. — B: Let's go inside, the air conditioner is on.

text: Are you a coffee person or a tea person?
ipa: /ɑːr jə ə ˈkɔːfi ˈpɜːrsən ɔːr ə tiː ˈpɜːrsən/
meaningVi: Bạn là dân mê cà phê hay mê trà?
example: A: Are you a coffee person or a tea person? — B: Definitely coffee!

text: Have you tried that new restaurant on the corner?
ipa: /həv jə traɪd ðæt nuː ˈrestərɑːnt ɑːn ðə ˈkɔːrnər/
meaningVi: Bạn ăn thử cái nhà hàng mới ở góc đường chưa?
example: A: Have you tried that new restaurant on the corner? — B: Not yet. Is it good?

text: I heard there's a big storm coming this weekend.
ipa: /aɪ hɜːrd ðerz ə bɪɡ stɔːrm ˈkʌmɪŋ ðɪs ˈwiːkend/
meaningVi: Nghe nói cuối tuần này có bão lớn đấy.
example: A: I heard there's a big storm coming this weekend. — B: Really? I'd better stay home then.

text: Sorry, what were we talking about?
ipa: /ˈsɑːri wʌt wər wi ˈtɔːkɪŋ əˈbaʊt/
meaningVi: Xin lỗi, nãy mình đang nói tới đâu rồi nhỉ?
example: A: That was my boss on the phone. Sorry, what were we talking about? — B: Your trip to Hue.

text: By the way, how's your new job going?
ipa: /baɪ ðə weɪ haʊz jər nuː dʒɑːb ˈɡoʊɪŋ/
meaningVi: À mà công việc mới của bạn sao rồi?
example: A: By the way, how's your new job going? — B: Pretty well! My team is really friendly.

text: Have you ever been to Da Nang? It's beautiful.
ipa: /həv jə ˈevər bɪn tə dɑː nɑːŋ ɪts ˈbjuːtəfəl/
meaningVi: Bạn đến Đà Nẵng bao giờ chưa? Đẹp lắm đấy.
example: A: Have you ever been to Da Nang? It's beautiful. — B: Not yet, but I'd love to go.

text: I'm really into cooking these days.
ipa: /aɪm ˈrɪli ˈɪntuː ˈkʊkɪŋ ðiːz deɪz/
meaningVi: Dạo này tôi mê nấu ăn lắm.
example: A: You post so many food photos! — B: Yeah, I'm really into cooking these days.

text: What kind of music do you listen to?
ipa: /wʌt kaɪnd əv ˈmjuːzɪk də jə ˈlɪsən tuː/
meaningVi: Bạn hay nghe thể loại nhạc gì?
example: A: What kind of music do you listen to? — B: Mostly pop, and some jazz.

text: Can you believe how expensive everything is now?
ipa: /kən jə bɪˈliːv haʊ ɪkˈspensɪv ˈevriθɪŋ ɪz naʊ/
meaningVi: Bạn thấy không, giờ cái gì cũng đắt kinh khủng!
example: A: Can you believe how expensive everything is now? — B: I know! Even a bowl of pho costs more.

text: Is this your first time at one of these events?
ipa: /ɪz ðɪs jər fɜːrst taɪm æt wʌn əv ðiːz ɪˈvents/
meaningVi: Đây là lần đầu bạn dự sự kiện kiểu này à?
example: A: Is this your first time at one of these events? — B: Yes, a colleague invited me.

text: That's interesting, I've never thought about it that way.
ipa: /ðæts ˈɪntrəstɪŋ aɪv ˈnevər θɔːt əˈbaʊt ɪt ðæt weɪ/
meaningVi: Hay đấy, tôi chưa từng nghĩ theo hướng đó.
example: A: Working from home actually makes me more social. — B: That's interesting, I've never thought about it that way.

text: Did you watch the football match last night?
ipa: /dɪd jə wɑːtʃ ðə ˈfʊtbɔːl mætʃ læst naɪt/
meaningVi: Tối qua bạn có xem trận bóng đá không?
example: A: Did you watch the football match last night? — B: Yes! What a goal at the end!
